firstPartyChecks.observation: Official municipal transparency page identifies La Ceiba cadastral reports and municipal cadastral administration.
Official SINIT La Ceiba page lists thematic map downloads and a request-layer route, without a demonstrated parcel-feature response.

firstPartyCache.observation: Blocked HTML, not JSON parcel data and unrelated to La Ceiba.

custody.assessment: Municipal cadastral custody is evidenced, but no La Ceiba polygon feature response or safe native parcel ID was obtained. Blocked SINAP routes and unrelated Nacaome metadata do not prove absence.

scopeCaveat: Packet completion and bounded or blocked responses do not establish citywide coverage or citywide cadastral absence.
